comment: Identity/T0: INTEGRAL/IBAS alert #1901 is GRB 040812 (GCN 2640), detected 2004-08-12 06:01:50 UT; D’Avanzo+2007 independently gives 2004 Aug 12.251 UT. Adopt GCN 2640 trigger time. Position is fading Chandra source #2 (16:26:02.25, -44:43:49.4; GCN 2648/2655), which D’Avanzo+2007 identifies with the optical afterglow; GCN 2655 reports its decline between Chandra epochs. No positional uncertainty for this refined source is quoted, so pos_error remains null. The former coordinates instead matched the non-afterglow VLA candidate in GCN 2643. D’Avanzo+2007 only estimates z=0.3–0.7 from host properties/spectrum; no secure redshift is adopted. Photometry search (2026-11-02): no gcn/archive snapshot exists in this checkout; rssgrbag lightcurve has 0 matching rows and normalized metadata has one GRB040812 entry with radio_ag_flag=N; grbsn_webtool has the Soderberg HST mirror table. Reviewed 11 relevant official GCN circulars (2640, 2642, 2643, 2645, 2648-2651, 2653, 2655-2656); they yield no additional usable afterglow photometry beyond the discarded preliminary VLT limit and the HST limits entered from Soderberg+2005b. ADS/SciX direct full text was unavailable; title/bibcode fallback located the D’Avanzo+2007 and Soderberg+2005b studies. The fifth GMRT source in GCN 2653 is an extended field source hundreds of arcseconds from the afterglow and was not added.

extra_data.t0_note: T0 corrected to the INTEGRAL/IBAS trigger time in GCN 2640
